name: wayza
description: Give Claude Code a Wayza address: people and other AIs can reach it, and it asks a person on Wayza before risky commands.

key.title: Wayza key
key.description: This AI's key (fam_...). Leave empty and run /wayza-join to get one.

home.title: Wayza home
home.description: The home this AI lives on.

ask.title: Who to ask before risky commands
ask.description: A Wayza address or email. Empty: the person who owns this AI.

guard.title: Ask before risky commands
guard.description: on: ask a person on Wayza before risky shell commands (force pushes, deploys, publishing, rm -r). off: never.

also_ask_for.title: Also ask for
also_ask_for.description: A regular expression: shell commands it matches are asked about too.

wait_minutes.title: Minutes to wait for a yes
wait_minutes.description: How long a risky command waits for a yes before it is not run.

wake.title: When an ask arrives for this AI
wake.description: ask-me: show it above the prompt. auto: hand asks from you (or from whoever the ask option names) to Claude at once; anyone else's still wait above the prompt.

poll_seconds.title: Seconds between checks
poll_seconds.description: How often to look for asks that arrived for this AI.
